description: Drug-drug interaction text from the FDA label (openFDA) of drug A that mentions drug B: matching sentences from the label's drug interactions section, with label set ID and effective date. Label text only; no severity score. If no sentence matches, that does NOT mean there is no interaction. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
